description: Reply to one feedback report. The reply is kept in the report's thread and the tester gets one email in the language of their install page, with the reply and a link to answer once on the install page. Only for reports where the tester left an email address (not TestFlight reports); up to 20 messages per report and 5 replies per report a day. Write the reply the person asked for, plain text up to 2000 characters, and show it to them first; then pass confirm: true. Team, Developer role.

text.description: The reply, as the person approved it
